Farm view audit · before and after (mock-up, not live)

Every zoom level, by day and at night. Seven fixes rendered in a test copy of the Farm view; the live Farm view is unchanged until you say so. Stalls already use the approved colours: a sow #c9cec1, empty #f6f7f3, needs a look amber.

1

Farm level colours rooms by pen type, in status colours

Farrowing reads as "needs a look", nursery as "in progress", the sick room as urgent; empty Room 1 and Room 3 look as full as Room 2.

Fix: The same ladder as a room at every level: a sow = neutral, empty = near-white, amber only where a pen needs a look. The type stays in the label.

2

Batch view paints the batch’s stalls pink

The last pink on the map; it means only "in this batch".

Fix: The batch’s stalls a step darker than occupied; every other stall near-white.

3

At night, empty stalls turn light blue

Night light on the near-white reads as the blue "in progress".

Fix: A warm off-white for empty stalls at night, so they stay neutral.

4

The hover card outlives the room

After moving from Farrowing Room 2 to Gestation 1, Farrowing Room 2’s B12 card is still on screen.

Fix: The hover card clears whenever the view moves to another room or level.

5

Pen tags sit on the stalls they name

In Plan the B15 tag hides half of the amber B15 stall.

Fix: Each tag stands at its own stall’s end, so the stall’s colour stays visible.

6

Close up, tags sit across the aisle

B-row tags run beside C’s troughs; you can’t tell which row a tag belongs to.

Fix: Each tag on its own stall’s end, on its own row’s side.

7

Heat lamps glow orange by day

The warm pools look like the amber "needs a look" stall (A7).

Fix: The lamp glow is faint by day and full at night; A7 is the only warm stall by day.

8 · Your call: hover in the plain Farm view

It is a three-row card (task statuses plus tags like Thin and Note). Inside a task you set hover to one line. Not changed here.

9 · Found while checking: a stray box under the side panel

On a pen’s panel, a white box sticks out below the panel’s bottom edge (visible in 7, both shots). Not fixed in this mock-up.
